description: Business and community refer to the same thing and are interchangeable. Get completed sales, customers, gross sales, net revenue, and average order value for one managed business and period. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. FREE businesses cannot use this tool, regardless of individual feature rows. Call check_business_tool_access before collecting inputs. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

endDate.description: End of the reporting window (ISO 8601 date).

startDate.description: Start of the reporting window (ISO 8601 date).

timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example Asia/Singapore.
